summary: Socket head cap screw with a cylindrical head (5.5 mm diameter, 3 mm tall) and a 6 mm long shank. It has a hex drive socket (2.5 mm) in the head top. The modeled axis is z, with the head at +z and the shank toward -z, centered on the overall 9 mm length.

mountingSurfaces.description: Underside of the head (bearing surface), facing -z toward the shank, 3 mm below the head top.
Flat top face of the head containing the 2.5 mm hex drive socket.
Free end face of the shank, 6 mm below the head underside.

notes: The drawing gives head diameter 5.5 mm, head height 3 mm, hex socket 2.5 mm and a 6 mm length measured from the head underside to the shank end. Overall length is therefore 3 + 6 = 9 mm. The product data lists only the 6 mm length, which is the shank, not the full part. The hex socket is a non-round recess and its depth is not stated, so it is left out of the holes array. It is a blind recess about 2.5 mm across flats in the head top. The shank diameter is nominally 3 mm, from the M3 designation.
